hideWhenIdle.description: Hide the "Subagents · N running" widget completely while no subagent exists (default true). Set false to keep the box visible at zero.

reserveTokens.description: RESERVED (unimplemented). Mirrors pi-durable settings.compaction.reserveTokens: token headroom that triggers retirement hand-off. Adopted so a future migration to pi-core-native compaction settings is a rename, not a redesign.

keepRecentTokens.description: RESERVED (unimplemented). Mirrors pi-durable settings.compaction.keepRecentTokens: recent context preserved into the finish-and-hand-off summary.

backgroundTokens.description: RESERVED (unimplemented). Mirrors pi-durable settings.compaction.backgroundTokens: budget for background pre-retirement summarization.

watchdog.description: Dead-turn stall watchdog (PMR-YFRB). Opt-out: absent = on. Set enabled:false to restore legacy behavior (active snapshots never age into stalled).

enabled.description: Enable the stall watchdog (default true). false restores legacy never-age behavior.

streamStallAfterMs.description: Dead-turn deadline for streaming/provider scopes in ms (default 150000).

quietStallAfterMs.description: Dead-turn deadline for tool/turn/unknown scopes and sustained snapshot loss in ms (default 1800000).
